title: Hoodlum Soldier Ep 14: Full Circle

scenes.say: A judge calls. The same courthouse. Different reason.
scenes.visual: the exterior of a city courthouse on a bright morning, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: She wants him to talk to young men facing the same two choices.
scenes.visual: a group of young men in a courthouse waiting room, seen from behind, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: He walks through the doors he once walked through in cuffs.
scenes.visual: a man in a suit walking through courthouse doors, sunlight behind him, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text
polished marble courthouse floor reflecting light, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: He looks at a seventeen year old in orange and sees a mirror.
scenes.visual: an orange jumpsuit sleeve on a courtroom table, close up, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Nobody's coming to save you, he tells him. So save yourself.
scenes.visual: two men talking across a table, faces in shadow, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: But you don't have to do it alone.
scenes.visual: a hand placed on another's shoulder, warm light, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: The kid writes Ali's number on his hand.
scenes.visual: a phone number written in pen on the back of a hand, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Six months later, that kid texts him a picture of his diploma.
scenes.visual: a phone showing a photo of a graduation diploma, smiling hands, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: The courtroom that tried to end him became where he gives back.
scenes.visual: an empty courtroom with sunlight across the benches, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Follow for Episode Fifteen. Turn negative into positive.
scenes.visual: a gavel resting on a bench in golden light, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

caption: HOODLUM SOLDIER, Episode 14 of 25: Full Circle. The true-story series from the book by Elvin Torres Sr. New episode every 48 hours.
